subject: NimbusCloud payment posting gap — revenue mapping & JE needed
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NimbusCloud payment posting gap — routing to wrong revenue mapping

Team —

Quick summary: NimbusCloud submitted a single ACH for $142,350 on 2027-06-24. Payment hit AR but was posted to the global "deferred-services" AR bucket instead of the "professional-services" revenue mapping used for their onboarding project (Deal 10342). This is causing a mismatch in AR aging and the revenue schedule (we now show $0 applied to invoice INV-9072).

What I have so far: attached is the remittance they sent (nimbus_remittance_20270624.pdf) and a ledger extract showing the posting (posting_ledger_extract_0627.csv).

Asks:
- Marcus/Laura — can finance prepare a proposed journal entry to move the $142,350 from Deferred Services (AR bucket 2102) to Professional Services revenue (GL 4005) and update the invoice application so INV-9072 shows paid?
- Hiro — does this change require any revenue recognition reversal in the current month close, or can it be a reclass with a memo?

I can loop in the customer if you need a signed remittance confirmation — they included invoice numbers in the remittance but our posting didn't pick them up.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: posting_ledger_extract_0627.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbusCloud payment posting gap — routing to wrong revenue mapping

Thanks Hannah — I reviewed the ledger extract. Looks like the AR receipt (RCPT-20270624-338) was auto-applied to a catch-all AR bucket when invoice matching failed. We can do a correcting JE + re-apply to INV-9072.

Two quick questions before I draft the JE:
1) Confirm GL targets: credit 2102 (Deferred Services AR) and debit 1020 (Cash clearing) won't work — we should credit Cash/Bank (1010) with a reversing line and debit AR mapped to 4005 (Professional Services). I suggest the following top-level lines in the JE:
   - Debit: Contract Revenue Clearing (GL 4005) — $142,350
   - Credit: Deferred AR (GL 2102) — $142,350
2) Do we need contract-level memo linking to INV-9072 and the HubSpot deal? I will include HubSpot: 98675 in the JE reference.

Laura — can you confirm the account codes and sign off on the JE? If yes, I'll prepare a spreadsheet (proposed_je_nimbus_0629.xlsx) and post it to Drive and start the re-application once we have customer confirmation that the remittance matches the invoice list.

-Marcus
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: NimbusCloud payment posting gap — JE posted and invoices applied

All —

Final update: we prepared and posted the correcting journal entry (JE-20270630-8271). Summary:
- Credit: Deferred AR (GL 2102) — $142,350
- Debit: Professional Services Revenue Clearing (GL 4005) — $142,350
- Re-applied payment RCPT-20270624-338 to INV-9072 ($98,100) and INV-9120 ($44,250).

Notes:
- JE posted to the June adj GL batch; revenue recognition doesn't require a reversal for May close because these invoices were not previously recognized — we updated the contract memo and linked HubSpot: 98675.
- Alicia, thanks for confirming the remittance. We attached the JE spreadsheet (proposed_je_nimbus_0629.xlsx) to the Drive link for audit.

Closing this thread — AR aging reflects the correction and the unapplied balance is cleared. Please re-open if you see any downstream variances on the SaaS billing dashboard.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
